profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker DT, with SEC CIK 0001773383. On its own site the company describes itself as an observability provider built for the age of AI, offering observability, AI, automation, and application security in a single platform, and says it aims to turn data into decisions and autonomous actions. It calls itself the AI-powered observability leader.

The site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer quote on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing root cause identification time from hours to minutes. No specific products are listed in the company's tracked record.

The held record shows litigation exposure in Massachusetts, with 191 cases. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or products are otherwise recorded.
